external_entities.name: Previous Validator Client
external_entities.description: The validator client that exported the interchange file being imported

ambiguities.text: The specification states to treat missing signing_root as potential conflicts but does not define the exact behavior
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume missing signing_root means the validator client should refuse to sign any message at that same slot (for blocks) or same source/target epoch combination (for attestations). This is the most conservative interpretation.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'merge by taking maximum slot/epoch values' for minimal implementations lacks precise merge semantics
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume merging means: for each validator, take the maximum of (existing min_slot, imported max_slot) for blocks and (existing min_source_epoch, imported max_source_epoch) and (existing min_target_epoch, imported max_target_epoch) for attestations.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when the same validator public key appears multiple times in the data array
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume duplicate public keys should be merged, combining all their signed_blocks and signed_attestations records. Reject the import if records conflict.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator is completely stopped and not signing any messages during the import/export process
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Race conditions could occur where the validator signs a conflicting message between export and import, leading to slashing

implicit_assumptions.description: The interchange file was exported from a legitimate validator client and has not been maliciously modified
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A tampered interchange file could be crafted to allow slashable signing by omitting critical historical records

implicit_assumptions.description: The genesis_validators_root uniquely identifies a network and prevents cross-network imports
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If two networks share the same genesis_validators_root, slashing protection from one network could be incorrectly applied to another

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot cause the validator to import a file while the validator is actively signing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Time-of-check to time-of-use vulnerabilities could allow slashable signing during import
